$comment: Committed baseline for rule_force_delegate's cost budget in .claude/hooks/pretool-check.sh (ADR-005: docs/10-architecture/06-adr-005-force-delegate-cost-budget.md, measured revision). Highest-version file wins, so a deliberate threshold change is a new file and a reviewable diff. v1.1.0 supersedes v1.0.0: the byte meter now measures tool output that actually entered the main session (read from the session transcript) instead of estimating each call's cost before it runs, so the pre-call Bash charges (bash_bounded_charge_bytes, bash_unbounded_charge_bytes) no longer exist.
byte_to_token_basis: Unchanged from v1.0.0 (FF9's basis): ~4 characters per token for English/markdown/code text. Used only to show an approximate token figure in deny and warning messages.

thresholds.byte_budget_basis: ~50,000 tokens, which is v1.0.0's own stated target of ~5% of the context window, applied to the 1M-token window sessions now run with (v1.0.0 sized 5% of a 200K window). Calibrated on 38 retained main-session transcripts measured the same way the hook now measures (2026-09-18): 17 exceeded v1.0.0's 40,000 bytes, so the old threshold tripped on ordinary work once measured honestly; 2 exceeded 200,000 bytes (311,691 and 363,023), the genuine main-session sprawl this rule exists to stop; none exceeded 400,000. The meter resets at compaction, since compaction removes the measured output from context.
thresholds.files_budget_basis: Unchanged from v1.0.0: ~1.7x protocol-injection.md's 3-file main-session guidance. Counts only Read/Edit/Write file_path targets, which are exact before the call runs. Resets at compaction together with the byte meter.
thresholds.warning_ratio_basis: Unchanged from v1.0.0: emit an advisory at 80% of either meter, before the deny.
thresholds.image_block_basis: Flat charge for a non-text tool_result block (an image or document read into the session), whose transcript form is base64 and would badly overstate its context cost if counted as text. ~1,500 tokens at the 4.0 byte_to_token_ratio, a typical screenshot-sized image. The only estimate left in the meter.
